canonical_identity.title: Munda Tribe of Bihar and Jharkhand (Vol. X)
canonical_identity.subject: Community Lifestyle

scope.catalogue_description_summary: NCAA describes the film as documentation of Munda people in Bihar/Jharkhand and as probing displacement/impoverishment in the aftermath of development.
scope.scope_warning: Catalogue metadata is evidence about the archival object, not sufficient evidence for the documentary's cultural or historical propositions. The spatial field 'Bihar' and title/description reference to Jharkhand must be preserved rather than silently harmonized.

technical_metadata.codec: H.264 / AVC / MPEG-4 AVC / MPEG-4 part 10

canonicalization.dedup_rule: Treat archival catalogue record, digitized manifestation, technical/condition reports, previews, mirrors and citations for CVI-BETA_1177-BC as manifestations/components of one audiovisual work, not independent corroboration.
canonicalization.series_rule: Do not merge Vol. X with other numbered volumes in the 18-part relation; each volume may be a distinct archival object but series-level dependency must be retained.

evidence_promotion.reason: The authoritative catalogue verifies the audiovisual object's identity and technical metadata, but proposition-level cultural evidence requires lawful access to the recording plus provenance, consent, locality, speaker/scene and dependency review.

exact_locator_conversion_plan: Obtain lawful authoritative access to CVI-BETA_1177-BC without bypassing access controls.
Record manifestation identity/hash only where storage and processing are permitted.
Create HH:MM:SS segment locators for each candidate proposition rather than citing the film as a whole.
Distinguish narration/editorial framing from participant speech, observed events, archival inserts and cited/borrowed material.
Verify recording locality/date and participant/speaker identity only when the source supports them.
Retain uncertainty and do not generalize filmed communities to all Munda communities.
Apply participant/privacy, performer, sacred/restricted-cultural and community-consent gates before graph promotion.
